def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']

    entity_list = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list)

    feature_names = [
        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
        'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_last_180',
        'avg_price_last_90', 'avg_price_last_180', 'avg_price_prev',
        'trend_price_90', 'n_sellers_last_90',
        'avg_days_between_orders', 'freq_orders_per_month',
        'avg_review_last_90',
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    # --- Только продажи, состоявшиеся до seed_time ---
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & \
           (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask, ['product_id', 'order_id', 'seller_id',
                                   'price', 'freight_value', 'ts']]

    if not items.empty:
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('price', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max'),
        )
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['has_sales'] = 1.0

        # Частота заказов
        n_orders = agg['n_orders']
        freq = n_orders / agg['lifetime_days'].clip(lower=30) * 30.0
        agg['freq_orders_per_month'] = freq

        # Средний интервал между заказами
        ord_times = items[['product_id', 'order_id', 'ts']].drop_duplicates('order_id')
        ord_times = ord_times.sort_values(['product_id', 'ts'])
        gaps = ord_times.groupby('product_id')['ts'].apply(
            lambda s: s.diff().dropna().dt.days.mean() if len(s) > 1 else np.nan
        )
        agg['avg_days_between_orders'] = gaps

        base_cols = ['n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price',
                     'std_price', 'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers',
                     'days_since_first', 'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days',
                     'has_sales', 'freq_orders_per_month',
                     'avg_days_between_orders']
        for col in base_cols:
            features.loc[agg.index, col] = agg[col].values

        # --- Скользящие окна по продажам ---
        ord_times = ord_times.set_index('ts')
        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            w = ord_times[(ord_times.index >= cutoff) & (ord_times.index <= seed_time)]
            if not w.empty:
                counts = w.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
                features.loc[counts.index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = counts.values

        # --- Средняя цена в окнах и тренд ---
        items_idx = items.set_index('ts')
        for period, col in [(90, 'avg_price_last_90'), (180, 'avg_price_last_180')]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            w = items_idx[(items_idx.index >= cutoff) & (items_idx.index <= seed_time)]
            if not w.empty:
                mp = w.groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
                features.loc[mp.index, col] = mp.values
        prev_cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
        prev_end = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        w_prev = items_idx[(items_idx.index >= prev_cutoff) &
                           (items_idx.index < prev_end)]
        if not w_prev.empty:
            mp = w_prev.groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
            features.loc[mp.index, 'avg_price_prev'] = mp.values
        features['trend_price_90'] = features['avg_price_last_90'] - features['avg_price_prev']

        # --- Продавцы в окне 90 дней ---
        cutoff90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        w90 = items_idx[(items_idx.index >= cutoff90) & (items_idx.index <= seed_time)]
        if not w90.empty:
            ns = w90.groupby('product_id')['seller_id'].nunique()
            features.loc[ns.index, 'n_sellers_last_90'] = ns.values

        # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже опубликованы к seed_time ---
        uniq_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        rev = reviews.loc[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time,
                          ['order_id', 'review_score']]
        rev Joined = None  # placeholder removed below
        rev_j = uniq_orders.merge(rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if not rev_j.empty:
            rev_agg = rev_j.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(
                avg_review_score='mean', std_review_score='std', n_reviews='count')
            for col in ['avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews']:
                features.loc[rev_agg.index, col] = rev_agg[col]

            cutoff90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
            rev90 = reviews.loc[(reviews['review_creation_date'] >= cutoff90) &
                                (reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time),
                                ['order_id', 'review_score']]
            rev_j90 = uniq_orders.merge(rev90, on='order_id', how='inner')
            if not rev_j90.empty:
                mr = rev_j90.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].mean()
                features.loc[mr.index, 'avg_review_last_90'] = mr.values

    features = features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    return features
